column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-6 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. The join is two-way and total, so a check that
# exists but is claimed by no surface fails the gate, and a surface naming an id nothing
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   checks    the check ids tools/workflow_calculus_gate.py implements
# `obligation-ledger-balances` and `every-workflow-replayed` are two surfaces over one
# table because they are two claims: that each workflow's accounting closes, and that every
# workflow the table names was actually run rather than assumed.
# The last two surfaces are the ones this register cannot reach. Binding a claim to the
# fixture that discharges it is the evidence calculus's, which is the next phase's; and
# nothing here provisions anything, so a provider that fails to delete what it was asked to
# delete stays the live-effect observation section 3 says it is. Both carry a metric whose
# recorded value is the literal UNVERIFIED.
